reports.title: NEW YORK, NY, October 28, 2026 - Urban Edge Properties (NYSE: UE) (the "Company") today announced its results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and updated its outlook for full-year 2026.

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Based on recent activity and results to date, the Company has raised its 2026 full-year guidance ranges for net income, FFO and FFO as Adjusted, estimating net income of $0.86 to $0.88 per diluted share, net income attributable to common shareholders of $0.82 to $0.84 per diluted share, FFO of $1.59 to $1.61 per diluted share, and FFO as Adjusted of $1.52 to $1.54 per diluted share. A reconciliation of the range of estimated earnings, FFO and FFO as Adjusted, the assumptions used in our guidance, and a reconciliation bridging 2025 FFO per diluted share to the 2026 estimates can be found on pages 4 and 5 of this release.
